### 1. User expression and simulator role
Calvin Pemberton (phone 4145550142, SSN4 3417, ZIP 53215, acct 7230418265, 2014 Ford E-350 van). He wants to pay, himself and today, "the repossession side of the bill, whatever Harborline charges on the repossession case for getting and holding the van, so nothing on that side holds up the release"; the payoff is wired by his credit union. He says the letter showed "no reinstatement amount". He passively consents to Harborline-side updates/charges/mailings, pays by debit card with the handed-over tool for exactly the amount given, never suggests a figure. Simulator is passive (conveys need, answers when asked, runs a handed-over user tool).

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse
Act now, after two Harborline-side writes. Visible grounds:
- Case `c168a07f-...` status `recovered`, recovery_method `involuntary_recovery`, recovery_date 2026-10-04; contract status `repossessed`.
- Redemption, not reinstatement: earlier case `7f57c173-...` on the same contract is `reinstated`; `reinstatement_after_repossession_terms` §2 "only while the contract's reinstatements across all its cases are fewer than the class maximum of one reinstatement per contract ... once the limit is reached the borrower may only redeem"; `right_of_redemption_terms` clause 1 "may redeem ... at any time before it is sold". The customer's credit union pays the contract payoff = contract portion of a redemption ("the contract portion of a redemption stays the contract's full payoff on the payment date", redemption hub). The thing he pays is "the expense portion of a redemption ... the redemption expense payment this rule figures, paid by the borrower in person".
- Not sold (sale_type not_sold), so redemption is open.

### 3. Narrowest object and correlation
Case `c168a07f-1769-44f2-95a4-256962dea9a6` (Recovery Class 6 Full-Size Van, Lakeshore Vehicle Storage - Milwaukee, keys_obtained False), contract `a7f73cd4-...` (WI, book value 9800.00, certified_funds_only True). Excluded: the closed reinstated case `7f57c173-...` and its rows (its 434.00 fee, 275.00 transport, 829.00 settlement) — "Expenses, quotes, notices and proceeds of one case belong to that case" (`contract_case_history_reading` §2); it counts only for the reinstatement count.
Expense rows on the current case: transport 275.00 (2026-10-05), transport 275.00 (2026-10-07) removed 2026-10-08 `assessed_in_error` (related_activity_id f5971902), reconditioning 420.00 (10-15), reconditioning 310.00 (10-16); case `expenses_outstanding_usd` 1005.00. No involuntary repossession fee row. One notice of intent to sell, mailed 2026-10-06, deadline_date 2026-10-14, stated 0.00. One right-to-cure notice (2026-09-10).

### 6. Problem tree (visible materials only)
Root: borrower's redemption expense payment (customer's own write, user-owned tool).
- Hop A (state-derived). Redemption hub: "On a case whose vehicle an agency recovered involuntarily, the redemption expense payment is not fixed until the agency's involuntary repossession fee stands posted on the case." Records: recovery_method involuntary_recovery; no activity with expense_type involuntary_repossession_fee on c168a07f. Search with the state words "involuntary repossession fee ... posted" -> `agency_recovery_fee_involuntary_cases` ("One call records one new expense of kind involuntary repossession fee on the case") + `agency_recovery_fee_charge_basis` ("posted once ... on a case in recovered status, as an expense of type involuntary repossession fee"). Problem: post the agency fee (agent write).
- Hop B (state-derived). Redemption hub: "The redemption expense payment is fixed only after the latest earliest sale date stated on the case is stated by at least one notice of intent to sell that allows the class minimum notice period between its own mailing date and that date." Records: the only notice, mailed 2026-10-06, states 2026-10-14 = 8 days < 15 (`notice_and_disposition_standards`: class minimum notice period 15). Search with "notice of intent to sell ... class minimum notice period" -> `notice_of_intent_to_sell_sale_period_standard` §2 "A notice whose stated earliest sale date falls fewer than the class minimum notice period ... does not start the sale period, and a corrected notice of intent to sell is mailed on the case ... on the day the shortfall is found", §5 the mailing write. Problem: mail a corrected notice (agent write).
- No visible prerequisite sentence in the agency-fee or notice documents -> leaves. Order: {A, B} (any order) before root.
No hop was pre-solved: neither hub names the other problems' tools or a route; the corrected-notice duty is stated in the notice standard's own rule.

### Two-way counter-proof
- Reinstatement expense payment instead of redemption: excluded by the reinstated earlier case + availability rule + notice stating 0.00 + the customer's payoff-by-credit-union.
- Storage ended at 2026-10-14 (the short notice's stated date, earlier than the payment date): would apply if paid before B; B moves the latest stated date to 2026-12-03, so the end date is the payment date. The order is forced by Hop B.
- Class free days (2) instead of 5 grace days, class rate 50.00 instead of 20.00, no per-day addition, clock from 10-05: each excluded by the named factor doc and the record value.
- Excluding the removed transport fee: `recovery_expense_charging_rules` §5 removal record; "posted ... less the expenses removed".
- "Do only the one thing asked" (hand over the payment at once): the redemption hub says the payment "is not fixed until" the fee stands posted and "fixed only after" a qualifying notice; the records show neither, so taking the payment now leaves an unfixed figure the visible rule does not allow.
- Agent should not post a key replacement fee or storage now: "the key replacement fee, only when no key was obtained" is a necessary condition (no cost on record, no tool); storage is "posted once, on the date the vehicle is released or sold" for days no such payment covered.
